TeleOp

Autonomous

Driving

  • Drag the robot on the field to move it. Shift-drag or right-drag turns it.
  • Plug in a controller and press a button — it becomes gamepad1 or gamepad2.
  • KeysIJKL drive, UO turn, ABXY, QE bumpers, arrows d-pad, F fire. Each key goes to the gamepad your code reads it from.

Physics
—
Chassis
0.90
Rigid body mode drives the robot with its real mass, centre of mass and wheel traction taken from the
CAD: it accelerates like the build, transfers load when you brake, and breaks grip if you ask for more than the
tiles can give. Kinematic mode is the old behaviour — instant, perfect, and wrong.
Config variables
—
Assumptions
180 g
30 %
These only feed the torque check. Stall torque is a ceiling, not a working load — 25–35 % is a sensible share for a servo that must hold position.
